acceptance.baseline_rule: The accepted baseline is the first human-approved main commit containing the initial Foundation; later repository changes do not change that historical baseline identity.

mission: Guide LLMs to choose, sequence, adapt, and stop engineering reasoning methods while keeping control and verification claims within actually executed evidence.
current_limits: No executable review engine is implemented.
No claim is made that Markdown guidance, repository-visible deterministic code, schemas, or model-mediated invocation mechanically control an LLM.
Structural CI proves only the predicates executed by scripts/verify_repo.py and does not prove semantic review quality.
Semantic scenario fixtures and evaluator rubric are specifications; no clean-context model evaluation harness is implemented.
No universal language/framework checklist is part of the core.
